keys: Every failed board, flight or finale costs 1 life. Lives restore one at a time: 1 life every 12 hours, up to 9. Daily Missions stay open.
Failing a board, flight or chapter finale in this chapter costs 1 global life. Training and saved progress stay free. Lives restore one at a time: 1 life every 12 hours, up to 9.

Complete LIFE #1 through LIFE #9 — one new chapter per day: after you finish a chapter, the next one opens at 00:00 UTC (an invited friend who completes LIFE #1 can open one chapter early). You have 9 global lives: every failed board, flight or chapter finale costs 1 life (training and the first LIFE #1 tutorial are free). At 0 lives missions pause until a life restores. Lives restore one at a time: 1 life every 12 hours, up to 9.

You have up to 9 global lives. Every failed board, flight or chapter finale costs 1 life; training and your first LIFE #1 run are free. Lives restore one at a time: 1 life every 12 hours, up to 9. At 0 lives missions are paused until a life restores.
legacyKeys: Every failed board, flight or finale costs 1 life. Each life restores 12 hours after it was spent. Daily Missions stay open.
Failing a board, flight or chapter finale in this chapter costs 1 global life. Training and saved progress stay free. Lives restore 12 hours after they are spent.

Complete LIFE #1 through LIFE #9 — one new chapter per day: after you finish a chapter, the next one opens at 00:00 UTC (an invited friend who completes LIFE #1 can open one chapter early). You have 9 global lives: every failed board, flight or chapter finale costs 1 life (training and the first LIFE #1 tutorial are free). At 0 lives missions pause until a life restores — each spent life restores after 12 hours.

You have up to 9 global lives. Every failed board, flight or chapter finale costs 1 life; training and your first LIFE #1 run are free. Each spent life restores automatically 12 hours later. At 0 lives missions are paused until a life restores.

en: Lives restore one at a time: 1 life every 12 hours, up to 9.
Each life restores 12 hours after it was spent.
Lives restore 12 hours after they are spent.
— each spent life restores after 12 hours.
Each spent life restores automatically 12 hours later.
ru: Жизни восстанавливаются по очереди: 1 жизнь каждые 12 часов, максимум 9.
— каждая потраченная жизнь возвращается через 12 часов.
Каждая потраченная жизнь восстанавливается автоматически через 12 часов.
uk: Життя відновлюються по черзі: 1 життя кожні 12 годин, максимум 9.
— кожне витрачене життя повертається через 12 годин.
Кожне витрачене життя відновлюється автоматично через 12 годин.
es: Las vidas se recuperan de una en una: 1 vida cada 12 horas, hasta un máximo de 9.
Cada vida se recupera 12 horas después de gastarla.
Las vidas se recuperan 12 horas después de gastarse.
; cada vida gastada se recupera a las 12 horas.
Cada vida gastada se recupera automáticamente 12 horas después.
pt: As vidas voltam uma de cada vez: 1 vida a cada 12 horas, até o máximo de 9.
Cada vida volta 12 horas depois de gasta.
As vidas voltam 12 horas depois de gastas.
— cada vida gasta volta após 12 horas.
Cada vida gasta volta automaticamente 12 horas depois.
de: Leben werden nacheinander aufgefüllt: 1 Leben alle 12 Stunden, bis zu maximal 9.
Jedes Leben kehrt 12 Stunden nach dem Verbrauch zurück.
Leben kehren 12 Stunden nach dem Verbrauch zurück.
— jedes verbrauchte Leben kehrt nach 12 Stunden zurück.
Jedes verbrauchte Leben kehrt nach 12 Stunden automatisch zurück.
fr: Les vies reviennent une par une : 1 vie toutes les 12 heures, jusqu’à un maximum de 9.
Chaque vie revient 12 heures après avoir été dépensée.
Les vies reviennent 12 heures après avoir été dépensées.
— chaque vie dépensée revient après 12 heures.
Chaque vie dépensée revient automatiquement 12 heures plus tard.
it: Le vite tornano una alla volta: 1 vita ogni 12 ore, fino a un massimo di 9.
Ogni vita torna 12 ore dopo essere stata spesa.
Le vite tornano 12 ore dopo essere state spese.
— ogni vita spesa torna dopo 12 ore.
Ogni vita spesa torna automaticamente dopo 12 ore.
tr: Canlar sırayla yenilenir: her 12 saatte 1 can, en fazla 9 can.
Her can harcandıktan 12 saat sonra geri gelir.
Canlar harcandıktan 12 saat sonra geri gelir.
— harcanan her can 12 saat sonra geri gelir.
Harcanan her can 12 saat sonra otomatik geri gelir.
he: החיים מתחדשים בזה אחר זה: יחידת חיים אחת בכל 12 שעות, עד למקסימום של 9.
כל חיים חוזרים 12 שעות אחרי שנוצלו.
— כל חיים שנוצלו חוזרים אחרי 12 שעות.
כל חיים שנוצלו חוזרים אוטומטית אחרי 12 שעות.
ar: تعود الأرواح واحدة تلو الأخرى: روح واحدة كل 12 ساعة، حتى 9 أرواح كحد أقصى.
تعود كل روح بعد 12 ساعة من إنفاقها.
تعود الأرواح بعد 12 ساعة من إنفاقها.
— كل روح مُنفقة تعود بعد 12 ساعة.
تعود كل روح مُنفقة تلقائيًا بعد 12 ساعة.
zh: 生命逐条恢复：每 12 小时恢复 1 条，最多 9 条。
每条生命在消耗 12 小时后恢复。
生命在消耗 12 小时后恢复。
——每条消耗的生命在 12 小时后恢复。
每条消耗的生命会在 12 小时后自动恢复。
